llm.summary: This skill coherently implements disclosed Notion-backed emotional memory, journaling, and continuity helpers, with sensitive but purpose-aligned storage behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses Notion credentials, explicit database/data-source IDs, and local workspace memory files; this is sensitive but proportionate to externalized memory/journal functionality and is repeatedly documented.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install hooks, postinstall scripts, external npm dependencies, obfuscated loaders, or remote payload retrieval were found; metadata discloses Node, Notion auth, and the notion-api-automation dependency.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are detailed and persona-oriented, including first-person self-state handling and optional read-only subagent delegation, but they include boundaries against inventing user psychology, automatic profile promotion, and unverified memory claims.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence consists of Notion records plus local workspace JSON receipts/state files; ambient recall is enabled by default when its scripts are scheduled, but the artifact does not install cron jobs, services, backdoors, or system-level persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is emotion-linked memory recall, self-state, subjective journaling, and identity continuity; the inspected scripts create/query/write Notion memory, event, emotion, state, and journal records and manage bounded local mirrors/receipts for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want the agent to store emotional memories, self-state, and journal material in your Notion workspace and local OpenClaw memory files. Use a least-privilege Notion integration, keep database IDs and tokens out of chat/logs, review any scheduled cron/heartbeat setup separately, and set SIS_AMBIENT_RECALL=0 if you do not want ambient recall staging.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The scanner's mismatch claims do not hold when the whole package is inspected: setup, schema patching, migration, read, write, and test scripts are support tooling for the disclosed Notion-backed memory/journal workflow.
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced files were present in the artifact and inspected, including experience_recall.js, continuity_check.js, identity_diff.js, and ambient recall helpers; no analysis-evasion behavior was supported.
[PE3] unexpected: The .env-related hit is from test environment cleanup/mock execution, not production credential-file loading; production auth is via disclosed NOTION_* environment variables or OpenClaw SecretRef.
[RA1] unexpected: The cited 'Update skill' text is an error/help compatibility hint for notionctl, not code that modifies the skill or its configuration.
[MP3] expected: The skill intentionally maintains local memory/ambient-recall state, but the cited delete operation only removes an internal transient _loadError field before writing state and is not evidence of memory poisoning.
[SQP-2] expected: The sensitive Notion storage behavior is central to the purpose and is disclosed, though users should still treat emotion, self-state, and journal entries as private cloud data and configure access accordingly.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: AIG SARIF reported no results; independent inspection likewise found no hidden remote execution, system persistence, tool hijacking, or destructive behavior.
